en: The image shows a black-and-white photograph of several people by a rocky riverbank. Three women and a child are kneeling on rocks, washing clothes in the river, while two boys in traditional Mexican attire stand in the background. The women and girls wear traditional dresses, and the boys wear hats and ponchos. The setting is natural, with a backdrop of rocks and trees, suggesting a rural environment. The style of clothing and the activity depicted give the sense of early to mid-20th century rural Mexico. There is handwritten text on the bottom of the image.
